demo.title: even-steven.sh
demo.code:
# Open games, the line and the pools
node scripts/even-steven.bundle.mjs markets

# The line and the contract's quote for a 10 USDC stake
node scripts/even-steven.bundle.mjs odds "Packers Cowboys" --stake 10

# Step 1: prepare. Shows the line, the 2% fee and the total. Nothing is signed.
node scripts/even-steven.bundle.mjs bet --prepare "Packers Cowboys" Cowboys 10

# Step 2: after you reply confirm
node scripts/even-steven.bundle.mjs bet --confirm <intent-id>

# Your bets, and collecting a payout after settlement
node scripts/even-steven.bundle.mjs status "Packers Cowboys"
node scripts/even-steven.bundle.mjs claim "Packers Cowboys"

setup: Create a Bankr API key at bankr.bot/api-keys with Wallet API on, Read Only off and Trusted Addresses empty
Fund your Bankr wallet with USDC on Base (no ETH needed to bet)
Nothing to install: scripts/even-steven.bundle.mjs is a single file and needs only Node 20+
